eyebrow: AKS: control plane, then node pools, Saturday mornings only
code:
az aks upgrade \
  --resource-group northbridge-rg \
  --name northbridge-aks \
  --kubernetes-version 1.29.2

az aks maintenanceconfiguration add \
  --cluster-name northbridge-aks --name default \
  --weekday Saturday --start-hour 3
caption: Nodes are replaced one at a time by default — cordoned, drained, then upgraded.

code:
aws eks update-cluster-version \
  --name northbridge-eks --kubernetes-version 1.29

aws eks update-nodegroup-version \
  --cluster-name northbridge-eks \
  --nodegroup-name standard-workers
caption: Control plane upgrades first and can run one version ahead of the nodes — a staged rollout, not an all-at-once cutover.

eyebrow: The step that keeps Pods from dying all at once

steps.label: Then remove
steps.sub: only after Pods are safely off

eyebrow: A guardrail the upgrade itself has to respect
code:
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: checkout-pdb
  namespace: checkout
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: checkout }
caption: The rollout won't drain a node if it would drop checkout below 2 running replicas.
